_note: Fictional funding opportunities for the seminar and workshop. Every agency, rule, amount and date here is made up. DEMO-101 to DEMO-103 are the seminar storyline; DEMO-104 and DEMO-105 are decoys that a good search should not rank highly.

opportunities.title: Research Software Seed Fund
opportunities.summary: Maintenance and community growth for reusable, open-source research software.
opportunities.text: DEMO-101 · Research Software Seed Fund (fictional). Supports maintenance and community growth of reusable, open-source research software. Eligible: universities and nonprofit research institutes. Letter of intent due 10 Nov 2026; full application due 3 Dec 2026.

opportunities.title: Imaging Methods Accelerator
opportunities.summary: New imaging instruments and detector hardware, including AI-enabled microscopes. Hardware focus.
opportunities.text: DEMO-102 · Imaging Methods Accelerator (fictional). Funds the design and construction of new imaging instruments, detectors and microscopes, including AI-enabled acquisition hardware. Software-only projects are not a priority. Eligible: universities. Awards up to $750,000. Full application due 15 Jan 2027.

opportunities.title: Shared Data Infrastructure Program
opportunities.summary: Shared data repositories, pipelines and reproducible workflows used by several research groups. Rolling deadline.
opportunities.text: DEMO-103 · Shared Data Infrastructure Program (fictional). Supports shared data repositories, data pipelines and reproducible workflows that serve several research groups. Eligible: universities, nonprofit research institutes and research consortia. Awards up to $400,000. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis and reviewed quarterly.

opportunities.title: Coastal Ecology Field Stations
opportunities.summary: Field station upgrades for long-term coastal ecology monitoring.
opportunities.text: DEMO-104 · Coastal Ecology Field Stations (fictional). Funds equipment and facilities for long-term coastal ecology monitoring at field stations. Eligible: universities and state agencies. Awards up to $250,000. Full application due 20 Oct 2026.

opportunities.title: Teaching Innovation in Computing
opportunities.summary: Undergraduate course redesign in computing and data science. Closed for this cycle.
opportunities.text: DEMO-105 · Teaching Innovation in Computing (fictional). Supports redesign of undergraduate computing and data science courses. Eligible: universities and community colleges. Awards up to $150,000. Preliminary proposal due 1 Aug 2026; full application due 15 Sep 2026.
